name: Past Continuous
summaryPt: Ação em andamento em um momento específico do passado.

meaningUses.pt: Ação em andamento em um momento do passado
meaningUses.en: I was watching TV at 9 p.m.
She was cooking when I arrived.
He was studying while she was working.

formation.pattern: I was working — she was working — they were working
I wasn't working — they weren't working
Were you working? — Was she sleeping?

formation.pt: Yes, + pronome + was/were. No, + pronome + wasn't/weren't.
formation.pattern: Yes, I was. / No, she wasn't.

examples.en: A: Were you sleeping? B: Yes, I was.
examples.pt: A: Você estava dormindo? B: Sim.

subjectAgreement.example: I was working. She was working.
You were working. We were working. They were working.

spelling.pt: Mesmas regras do -ing do presente contínuo.
spelling.example: write → writing, run → running, die → dying

pronunciation.pt: was/were são geralmente átonos na fala.

commonErrors.pt: Usar passado simples quando a ação estava em andamento
commonErrors.wrong: I watched TV at 9 p.m. when he called.
commonErrors.right: I was watching TV at 9 p.m. when he called. (a ação estava em andamento)

commonErrors.wrong: She was cook when I arrived.
commonErrors.right: She was cooking when I arrived.

contrast.pt: Past simple = ação concluída. Past continuous = ação em andamento (como pano de fundo).
contrast.en: She cooked dinner. (concluiu) — She was cooking when I arrived. (em andamento)
contrast.enPt: Ela cozinhou o jantar. — Ela estava cozinhando quando cheguei.

examples.en: I was watching TV at 9 p.m.
She was cooking when I arrived.
He was studying while she was working.
